answers.prompt: S1. Light travels UP to the hit point and must leave LEFT. Choose the mirror tilt and normal direction below. Explain what the normal is.

answers.prompt: SE1. New direction: light now travels DOWN to the hit point and must leave LEFT. Choose the mirror and normal without reopening the teaching example.
